title: กรมอุตุฯ ประกาศฉบับที่ 11 เตือน 28 จังหวัดคาดจะได้รับผลกระทบจาก "ฝนตกหนัก"
desc: "กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา" ประกาศฉบับที่ 11 เตือน 28 จังหวัดคาดจะได้รับผลกระทบจาก "ฝนตกหนัก" อาจทำให้เกิดน้ำท่วมฉับพลัน-น้ำป่าไหลหลาก
title_cn: 气象部门发布第11号预警 28府防范暴雨洪灾
summary_cn: 泰国气象部门发布第11号预警，全国28个府可能受到暴雨影响，可能引发山洪和河洪灾害。预警涵盖全国大部分地区，民众需做好防灾准备，关注道路交通安全，警惕可能的泥石流和山体滑坡风险。

title: ราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 9 สิงหาคม 2569 อัปเดตล่าสุด "เบนซิน-ดีเซล" ลิตรละกี่บาท
desc: อัปเดตราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 9 สิงหาคม 2569 เช็กราคาน้ำมันทุกชนิด กลุ่มเบนซิน, แก๊สโซฮอล์, ดีเซล จากปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท., บางจาก, พีที, คาลเท็กซ์, ซัสโก้ และเชลล์ ล่าสุดราคาลิตรละกี่บาทแล้ว
title_cn: 8月9日泰国油品价格最新播报
summary_cn: 截至2026年8月9日，泰国各大加油站包括PTT、Bang Chak、PTG、Caltex、Esso和Shell汽油、汽油混合燃料及柴油等各类燃料价格出炉。报价涉及汽油95和91号汽油、E20汽油混合燃料和柴油等多种油品规格。消费者可查询当日各油品的单升价格，便于规划出行预算。
desc_original: อัปเดตราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 9 สิงหาคม 2569 เช็กราคาน้ำมันทุกชนิด กลุ่มเบนซิน, แก๊สโซฮอล์, ดีเซล จากปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท., บางจาก, พีที, คาลเท็กซ์, ซัสโก้ และเชลล์ ล่าสุดราคาลิตรละกี่บาทแล้ว

title: Amlo eyes 200 in exam fraud probe
desc: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.
title_cn: 反洗钱办公室扩大地方政府考试舞弊调查范围
summary_cn: 泰国政府继续扩大对地方政府公务员考试舞弊案的调查范围，反洗钱办公室（AMLO）正在追踪参与舞弊网络的200多人的资金交易记录和流向。此次调查涉及复杂的贿赂和作弊网络，预计还会有更多涉案人员被曝光和进一步的指控。
desc_original: The government has widened its local-government exam fraud probe, with the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) tracing the financial transactions of more than 200 people involved in the network.

title: Na Ladprao beer hall owner charged over fatal fire
desc: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.
title_cn: 那拉迪路啤酒厅（Na Ladprao）火灾案 老板遭控告
summary_cn: 曼谷那拉迪路啤酒厅上月发生火灾事故造成37人丧生、77人受伤，这是泰国近年最严重的公共安全事故之一。警方已对酒厅业主提出6项刑事指控，涉及场所安全管理不当和过失致死等罪名。
desc_original: Police have charged the owner of Na Ladprao beer hall with six offences following a fire last month that killed 37 people and injured 77 others.

title: Hospital graft claims 'unproven'
desc: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.
title_cn: 公共卫生部驳斥医院腐败指控「无证据支撑」
summary_cn: 泰国公共卫生部门正式否认有关社区医院挪用健康促进与疾病防控资金存在普遍腐败行为的指控。部门认为相关说法缺乏证据支撑，强调所有资金使用都符合规范并接受政府部门和审计机构的监督。
desc_original: The Ministry of Public Health has rejected claims of widespread corruption involving health promotion and prevention funds at community hospitals.

title: Down with the death penalty?
desc: A series of grisly murders has reignited one of the country's most enduring and divisive public debates: whether the death penalty remains necessary to protect society or whether the justice system should instead focus on improving law enforcement, rehabilitation and post-release supervision.
title_cn: 死刑存留之争：泰国重启司法制度大辩论
summary_cn: 一系列恶性谋杀案在泰国重新燃起对死刑制度长期存在的争议。支持者认为死刑是保护社会的必需措施，反对者则呼吁将重点转向改进执法效能、罪犯改造项目和释放后的社区监管。这一议题在泰国社会持续引发分化讨论。
desc_original: A series of grisly murders has reignited one of the country's most enduring and divisive public debates: whether the death penalty remains necessary to protect society or whether the justice system should instead focus on improving law enforcement, rehabilitation and post-release supervision.

title: No signs of bullying: witness
desc: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.
title_cn: 德昔林北榄学校枪击案无欺凌迹象
summary_cn: 泰国北榄府邦割县的德昔林北榄学校发生枪击事件后引起社会关注。总理阿努廷·詹威拉古尔引用证人证词指出，事件中并无欺凌行为的证据。总理呼吁公众应避免盲目推测欺凌是诱发事件的原因，应等待进一步调查结果。
desc_original: The public should avoid speculating that bullying had triggered the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Nonthaburi's Bang Kruai district, says Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

title: Govt speeds up rooftop solar scheme
desc: The government is stepping up work on a rooftop solar scheme aimed at promoting clean energy and reducing household electricity costs.
title_cn: 泰国加速屋顶太阳能推广计划
summary_cn: 泰国政府正在加速推进屋顶太阳能安装计划。这一举措旨在加大清洁可再生能源的推广力度，同时帮助普通家庭显著降低电费支出。通过鼓励居民安装屋顶太阳能系统，政府体现了在能源结构优化和可持续发展方面的坚定承诺，推动泰国朝向绿色能源转型。
desc_original: The government is stepping up work on a rooftop solar scheme aimed at promoting clean energy and reducing household electricity costs.

title: Court halts delay of Social Security poll
desc: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.
title_cn: 法院禁止延期社会保障委员会选举
summary_cn: 泰国中央行政法院做出临时禁令，暂停关于推迟社会保障委员会选举的官方公告。这一司法裁决维护了选举的进行权，为社保委员会选举的如期顺利进行扫除了法律障碍。选举将在法院最终判决前继续推进，保护了民众的参与权和制度的正常运转。
desc_original: The Central Administrative Court has ordered a temporary suspension of an announcement postponing the Social Security Board election, clearing the way for the poll to proceed until the court issues a final ruling.

title: สำเร็จลุล่วง ภารกิจนำส่งอวัยวะหัวใจ ดวงที่ 184 จากดอนเมืองไป รพ.ศิริราช เพียง 22 นาที
desc: ภารกิจสำเร็จลุล่วง ตำรวจแจ้งขอทาง นำส่งอวัยวะหัวใจดวงที่ 184 จากดอนเมืองไป รพ.ศิริราช ถึงมือแพทย์ทันเวลาที่กำหนด ใช้เวลาเพียง 22 นาที
title_cn: 泰国第184例心脏捐献运送成功，22分钟送达医院
summary_cn: 泰国成功完成第184例心脏器官捐献和运送任务。在警方协助下，捐献的心脏从廊曼机场快速运送至诗里拉吉医院，仅用22分钟送达外科医生手中。这充分体现了泰国器官移植协调系统的高效运作和紧急医疗服务的专业水准。

summary_cn: 泰国气象部门发布第10号通告，对多个府县发布预警，提醒注意8月8-9日期间可能出现的强降雨、洪水和山洪灾害，居民需做好防范准备。

desc: “วรศิษฎ์” ลงพื้นที่ลุยต่อเกาะสมุย ย้ำ ต้องปกป้องคนไทยไม่ให้ถูกรังแก ไม่ว่าคนเชื้อชาติใดต้องเคารพกฎหมายไทย รับปากพร้อมแก้น้ำประปาขาดแคลน
title_cn: 瓦罗瑟宣示保护泰国人权益 反对外籍人士骚扰苏梅岛商户
summary_cn: 泰国官员瓦罗瑟（Worasen）到访苏梅岛（Koh Samui），强调保护泰国人权益，表明任何国籍人士在泰国都必须遵守当地法律，反对对本地商户的骚扰行为，同时承诺解决该岛缺水问题。

desc: “จุลพันธ์” เดินทางเข้าร่วมพิธีพระราชทานน้ำหลวงอาบศพ เหยื่อครูเหตุกราดยิงรร.เทพศิรินทร์ ห่วงใยทายาทผู้เสียชีวิตและผู้บาดเจ็บ สั่งการ สปส. เร่งเยียวยาทายาท ดูแลสิทธิประโยชน์เต็มที่

summary_cn: 泰国政府高级官员出席 Debsirin Nonthaburi School 枪击事件遇难者法事，对遇难和受伤者家属表示关切，并指示社会保障部门加快赔偿工作，确保受害者家族获得充分救济。

title: Court rules against embattled NBTC chief
desc: The Central Administrative Court has rejected a petition filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck seeking to overturn a ruling that found grounds for his removal, saying he had not yet suffered a legally actionable injury.
title_cn: 法院驳回 NBTC 主席诉讼请求
summary_cn: 泰国中央行政法院驳回了国家广播电信委员会（NBTC）主席 Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck 的请愿。该主席曾试图推翻一项认定他应被撤职的裁定，但法院认为其尚未遭受法律上可追究的伤害，因此驳回了其上诉。
desc_original: The Central Administrative Court has rejected a petition filed by National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck seeking to overturn a ruling that found grounds for his removal, saying he had not yet suffered a legally actionable injury.

title: Nene Royal’s ‘Hysteria’ tops 1 million views
desc: Thai rocker Nene Royal’s latest performance on ”America’s Got Talent” — a rendition of Muse’s “Hysteria” — has surpassed one million views online within just 14 hours of its release.
title_cn: 泰国摇滚歌手 Nene Royal 在美国达人秀创造百万播放纪录
summary_cn: 泰国摇滚歌手 Nene Royal 在美国电视节目《美国达人秀》上表演了 Muse 乐队的歌曲《Hysteria》，该表演视频发布仅 14 小时内就突破 100 万次观看，展现了泰国艺术家在国际舞台上的影响力。
desc_original: Thai rocker Nene Royal’s latest performance on ”America’s Got Talent” — a rendition of Muse’s “Hysteria” — has surpassed one million views online within just 14 hours of its release.

title: Police hope witnesses can shed light on school shooting
desc: Police are stepping up their investigation into the shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, questioning teachers, students and witnesses as they seek to determine what motivated a 14-year-old boy to kill eight people before taking his own life on Friday.
title_cn: 警方加紧调查学校枪击案 寻求目击证人协助
summary_cn: 泰国警方正在加紧调查 Debsirin Nonthaburi School 的校园枪击事件。一名 14 岁男生枪杀 8 人后自杀，警方目前正在询问教师、学生和目击证人，试图确定该少年的作案动机，案件调查仍在进行中。

title: SET executives upbeat on renewed investor confidence
desc: Thailand's stock market is regaining momentum as foreign investors return, supported by stronger capital inflows, improving economic fundamentals and new investment themes, according to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET).

title: Thailand pitches new deals to slash US tariffs
desc: Thailand pitches new deals to slash US tariffs Legacy Thailand is preparing a fresh round of proposals in its ongoing tariff talks with the United States , aiming to bring down the current 12.5% levy imposed under Section 301 through wider trade and investment cooperation. Vice Minister of Commerce Kirida Bhaopichitr gave an update on the negotiations, explaining that Thailand has faced two allegations from Washington. The first is that Bangkok lacks safeguards against imports made using forced labour. The second is that state subsidies to private industry have caused production overcapacity. On the forced labour issue, Kirida said Thailand has already signed a trade agreement with the US that resolves the matter. In return, Washington has granted tariff exemptions on more than 2,000 Thai products, covering roughly 60% of the kingdom’s exports to the US. Thailand has also pushed back on the overcapacity claim. Studies carried out with relevant agencies found that capacity utilisation in the industries Washington flagged, including automobiles and parts, rubber, pharmaceuticals, and machinery and equipment, sits between 75% and 95%. That, Kirida said, undercuts the US argument

title: True tie-up with university expands AI healthcare
desc: True Corporation has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) for academic cooperation with Thammasat University's Faculty of Medicine, Thammasat University Hospital, and EGG Digital to advance the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare.
title_cn: True公司与法政大学医学院合作推进医疗AI应用
summary_cn: True公司宣布与法政大学医学院、法政大学医院及EGG Digital签署学术合作备忘录，共同推进人工智能在医疗健康领域的创新应用。该合作将充分利用AI技术在医疗诊断、患者管理等方面的优势，是泰国医疗科技创新的重要举措，有助于提升泰国医疗服务的国际竞争力。

title: Regional airport upgrade plan taking off
desc: The government is betting on regional airports to drive Thailand's next wave of tourism and investment growth, with upgrades to facilities, flight routes and technology aimed at transforming them into economic gateways.
title_cn: 泰国地方机场升级计划全面推进
summary_cn: 泰国政府制定地方机场升级改造计划，通过完善基础设施、扩展航线网络、引进新技术等举措，将地方机场转变为区域旅游和投资的经济枢纽。该计划旨在推动泰国下一轮旅游和对外投资增长，打造利用地方机场带动区域经济发展的战略格局。
desc_original: The government is betting on regional airports to drive Thailand's next wave of tourism and investment growth, with upgrades to facilities, flight routes and technology aimed at transforming them into economic gateways.

title: Six years, six major shootings in Thailand
desc: Six years, six major shootings in Thailand Legacy The shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School on Friday, August 7, has renewed attention on a series of major shooting incidents across Thailand since 2020, spanning shopping centres, a childcare centre, schools and a Bangkok market. Seven people died in the Nonthaburi attack, including three teachers, three students and the student suspect. Another 15 people were injured, two of them seriously. The incident is the latest in a series of six major shootings identified by Nation TV, starting with the Korat attack in February 2020. 1. Korat, February 2020 Photo courtesy of Bangkok Post A soldier opened fire in Nakhon Ratchasima on February 8, 2020, with the attack extending to Terminal 21 shopping centre. title: Vietnam overtakes Thailand in flight capacity race
desc: Vietnam overtakes Thailand in flight capacity race Legacy Thailand has fallen to No.3 in Southeast Asia’s flight seat rankings for the second consecutive month, with Vietnam overtaking the kingdom on rising domestic demand. OAG’s August report found Vietnam’s flight capacity rose 10% year-on-year to 7.27 million seats, holding onto No.2 after first overtaking Thailand in July. Vietnam’s domestic capacity alone jumped 13.8% to more than 4.7 million seats. Thailand’s total capacity slipped 1.7% to 7.19 million seats, while Indonesia stayed at No.1 with 11 million seats, up 4.3%. Suvarnabhumi remained the region’s third-busiest airport with 3.22 million seats, up 1%, trailing Singapore’s Changi (3.64 million) and Jakarta (3.32 million). Don Mueang fared worse, dropping 7.5% to 1.52 million seats, as low-cost carriers based there, including Thai AirAsia, cut capacity by 23.4% to 1.44 million seats. Patsee Permvongsenee, executive director for Asean, South Asia and South Pacific at the Tourism Authority of Thailand, said the shift reflects Vietnam’s growing travel demand, multiple large airports, and bulk seat bookings and joint promotions
title_cn: 越南航班运力超越泰国，东南亚排名调整
summary_cn: 越南航班运力升至东南亚第二，泰国连续两月跌至第三。OAG八月报告显示，越南国内需求旺盛，总运力增长10%至727万座位。泰国总运力下滑1.7%至719万座位，印度尼西亚居首1100万。素万那普机场(Suvarnabhumi)排名区域第三，但廊曼机场(Don Mueang)的泰国亚航等廉价航空削减运力23.4%。越南多座大型机场和旺盛旅游需求推动了这一竞争格局转变。
